en-US.name: MOD Panel
en-US.description: In-game MOD panel: lists loaded mods with their versions, DLLs, GUIDs and hotkeys, plus a live keyboard map that highlights keys and shows what each one does.

zh-Hans.name: MOD 面板
zh-Hans.description: 游戏内 MOD 面板：列出已加载 mod 的版本、DLL、GUID 和各自快捷键，并用键盘图实时高亮按键、显示每个键的功能。
